source: Every figure below comes from the property PGManage was built to run — a 121-bed co-living property in Hyderabad. The property is not named and is not a customer; it is where the software was written and is used every day. Update numbers here and they change everywhere on the site.

stats.label: floors
stats.note: Physical layout of the property PGManage was built in — 7 floors.

stats.label: beds
stats.note: 121 rentable beds — the unit the whole product and pricing is counted in.

stats.label: residents living there
stats.note: 106 residents in the building at time of writing — 88% of 121 beds.

stats.label: occupancy
stats.note: 106 of 121 beds filled. Vacancy tracking is what keeps this number from slipping.

stats.label: of rent collected
stats.note: Share of billed rent collected in the month it was due, measured across the property.

stats.label: days to collect
stats.note: Days sales outstanding — average gap between rent falling due and rent landing. Sub-five is the point of the WhatsApp reminders.

stats.label: WhatsApp delivery
stats.note: Share of rent reminders and receipts that reached the resident's WhatsApp, measured from Meta delivery receipts.
